title: deployment.yaml
description: Structural schema mirroring services/platform-api/internal/domain/deployment_yaml.go and the checks in internal/service/validation_service.go, as of this package's last update. This is a fast, offline, first-pass check ONLY — it never substitutes for the server-side validate_application result. If this schema and validate_application ever disagree, validate_application is correct and this file is stale; see SKILL.md's 'Staying in sync' section.

name.description: Must exactly match the application's registered name. Also must independently satisfy the DNS-label naming rule enforced at registration time (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; starts with a letter).

owner.description: Confirmed with the employee, never inferred silently — an accountability field.

services.description: At least one service is required. Each key is a service name; becomes the top-level directory expected in the source_archive_base64 tar.gz passed to deploy_application.

runtime.description: Must be an exact, active entry name from the live get_supported_stacks result — see docs/supported-stack.md for a cached snapshot, but the live call is authoritative.

port.description: REQUIRED if runtime resolves to a backend-kind stack entry (validated server-side, not by this schema — this schema can't know a runtime's kind without calling get_supported_stacks). Omit for frontend-kind runtimes.

type.description: Only 'postgres' is supported as of this package's last update — confirm against the live catalog.

min.description: 0 (default) makes the service scale-to-zero eligible if it's a backend-kind service; >=1 opts out and keeps at least one instance always warm.

max.description: Must be >= min if both are set. There is currently no real horizontal scaling above 1 instance regardless of this value.

visibility.description: Explicitly confirmed with the employee, never guessed — a classification decision.
